title: Searching Job Titles
description:
Every job title really has multiple that could work for the same scope of work so when you're searching for a new job make sure you search those title variations to get as many search results as possible. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobseeker

transcript: tip number one for changing careers this is going to be figuring out the titles that you're actually going to search for two things we're looking for here is type and level if software engineer is kind of our umbrella title that could also be software developer full stack developer application developer front-end backend developer now the level is of course how experienced you are you might not be coming in as a junior maybe you're a mid-level senior or coming over from a different lead position all those different job types and job levels are Search terms and you want to make sure that you're searching for as many different things as possible under that main title umbrella
